lines.text: Many learners say: Please reply me soon.
Better: Please reply to me soon.
Reply to! Please reply to me soon.

native.tip: 中文说“回复我”，“我”直接跟在后面。英语 reply 后面要加 to。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Please reply me soon.”😅 中文说“回复我”不用介词，英语 reply 后面要加 to：“Please reply to me soon.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Please reply to me soon.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese puts me right after the verb, but English needs to.
en.caption: Do you say “Please reply me soon.” 😅 English needs to between reply and me: “Please reply to me soon.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
